Name: Simple Crayon Icons
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[center][size=6][b][color=#F9A8D4]Simple Crayon Icons[/color][/b][/size]
[size=4]A little box of crayons for your inventory.[/size][/center]

[center][size=4]The crayon style is based on [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/53823][b]Annabelle’s drawing skills[/b][/url] — colourful, playful little drawings for your inventory.[/size][/center]

[center][size=4]Bright colours, textured wax strokes and warm, uneven outlines give familiar items a playful illustrated look. Version 1.1 includes [b]1,583 supported inventory entries[/b]: 1,135 base item identities and 448 ingredient-specific variants.[/size][/center]

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54347/54347-1792701486-1003528857.png[/img][/center]

[center][size=5][b][color=#FDE68A]What's included[/color][/b][/size]
[size=4]Crops and seeds, forage, fish, cooking, minerals, resources, equipment, hats, machines and supported decorations. Ingredient-specific artisan goods have their own artwork, and regular eggs remain smaller than large eggs.

Crayon artwork appears in [b]inventory grids only[/b]. Stack numbers, quality stars and native item effects remain. World objects, the hotbar, tooltips, worn equipment, held items and tool actions keep their loaded artwork. This mod changes appearance; it does not add items or change their stats.[/size][/center]

[center][size=5][b][color=#86EFAC]Install[/color][/b][/size]
[size=4]For [b]Stardew Valley 1.6 on PC[/b] with [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI 4.0 or later[/url].
Download the main file, extract the [b]SimpleCrayonIcons[/b] folder into your game's [b]Mods[/b] folder, then launch through SMAPI. Content Patcher is not required.
To uninstall, remove the SimpleCrayonIcons folder.[/size][/center]

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54347/54347-1792701491-298253080.png[/img][/center]

[center][size=5][b][color=#67E8F9]Compatibility[/color][/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Choose Simple Crayon Icons OR Simple HD Icons.[/b] When Simple HD Icons is installed, Simple Crayon Icons deliberately stays inactive.

Unsupported items, custom item identities and items whose original sprite source has been changed by another mod fall back to their currently loaded artwork. This can produce a mix of crayon and other icons. The included catalogue does not cover every possible modded item.

Gallery images show the real mod artwork drawn in a controlled native inventory renderer. They are not screenshots from a played save. Android and every mod combination have not been certified.[/size][/center]

[center][size=5][b][color=#F9A8D4]Credits[/color][/b][/size]
[size=4]Original Creator: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Xsyy]xSyy[/url]
Crayon artwork was created using AI image generation, then fitted and reviewed for the inventory catalogue. Stardew Valley and its original item designs belong to ConcernedApe.[/size][/center]

[center][size=5][b][color=#FDE68A]Bugs and suggestions[/color][/b][/size]
[size=4]Please include the item name, a screenshot, your game and mod versions, and a [url=https://smapi.io/log]SMAPI log link[/url] when reporting a problem. Mention any other icon or item texture mods you use.

If you enjoy the crayon look, an endorsement is appreciated. Thank you![/size][/center]
